protocol.acceptance: Positive paired seed intervals for both-curved against calibration-selected positional control and for independent metric and connection contributions. Product target additionally requires doubled facts at 95% recall with no worse p95 latency and equal total bytes.
protocol.encoding: All arms receive the same noisy subject, exact ordered relation and attribute IDs, and noisy path coordinates. Each forward/reversed path pair has different values. Geometric features use per-coordinate distance frequencies and integer spin weights; these are a designed role-conditioned encoding, not learned neural geometry.
protocol.memory: Each arm uses the largest dimension in 32..=4096 fitting the same model payload cap. Payload includes complex128 accumulator, all codebooks, operator permutation/phase buffers, geometric coefficients, lookup table and model metadata. Actual source-witness Vec buffers are added equally to each arm; fixtures, allocator overhead and RSS are excluded.
protocol.selection: Nine distance/spin settings per arm, calibration seeds only, first-setting tie break. Strong positional baseline selected on calibration only. Held-out seeds start at seed+10000.
protocol.timing: Local indicative timings include path encoding, unbinding and exhaustive value decoding. Input corruption precedes timing. Held-out arm order rotates by seed; timings are not load-gated competitor claims.

scope: Stored complete paths with random labels; no unobserved multi-hop reasoning, neural learning, boundary codes or production integration.
